children.text: Please note that all schedules are subject to change due to weather conditions or unforeseen circumstances. Find us at
Av. De los Pioneros KM 5.000, San Carlos De Bariloche.
The Base complex (km 5) is open from 10:00 AM to 4:30 PM and is the starting point of your adventure. Purchase your entrance ticket at the Base and enjoy a spectacular ride to the summit.
The magic continues at the Summit, where you can enjoy the
and the best views until 5:45 PM. Take your time to relax and admire the scenery.
Buses depart from downtown to the Base every hour,
Return trips from the Base to downtown start at
11:15 AM and continue every hour until 6:15 PM.
